{{- /* The one way to render a contract image. Dimension attributes come from data/image_sizes.json (exporter-measured), so the browser reserves the box before the file arrives — layout never shifts when images land (CLS). Unmeasured images (SVG) simply omit the attributes; the reset's `height: auto` keeps the attrs acting as an aspect-ratio hint only. Args: src (contract path "images/…"), alt, class, loading ("lazy" default), fetchpriority. */ -}} {{- $dims := index (hugo.Data.image_sizes | default dict) .src -}}
